[SWS_WEth_00318] Value range of the returned buffer index
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00191
⌈The returned buffer index value of type Eth_BufIdxType shall be greater than 216-1.
The value range for the buffer index shall be:
• 0x00 01 00 00 ... 0xFF FF FF FF: valid
• 0x00 00 00 00 ... 0x00 00 FF FF: reserved for TxHandleId of WEth_Immedi-
ateTransmit
⌋
Note: Constraining the buffer index is needed, since TxHandleId of WEth_Immedi-
ateTransmit used for direct data provision (used as PDU-ID) and BufIdxPtr of
WEth_ProvideTxBuffer used for indirect data provision could overlap. EthIf need
an unambiguous id (non-overlapping value range) that corresponds to a transmission
request, to idenfy the affected tranmssion request for transmission confirmation via
EthIf_TxConfirmation.
